inclusionRules: Included: BodyParts3D concepts whose English name is a named ligament, plus interosseous membranes (syndesmoses) and flexor retinacula (deep fibrous / ligamentous layer). Excluded: calcaneal (Achilles) tendons, extraocular check ligaments, lens suspensory ligaments, trochleae, abstract parents, arteries. BodyParts3D 4.0 has no meshes for major joint ligaments (ACL/PCL, collaterals, iliofemoral, glenohumeral, etc.) nor joint capsules.
